text:
An elemental destroyer who specializes in two elements to unlock a master fusion.

Primary: INT | Secondary: WIS

MP mechanic: MP regenerates natively for spell costs. Choose Fire/Earth/Water/Wind at specialization, then choose again for a second element - your master/fusion spells unlock based on both choices.

Universal spells:
Arcane Bolt
Arcane Gate

Starter spells:
Fire Breath, Flame Lance (Fire)
Earth Spike, Stone Skin (Earth)
Frost Bolt, Tidal Wave (Water)
Wind Slash, Gale Force (Wind)

Plus all pure-element master spells and two-element fusion spells, unlocked based on your specialization choice.
